visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and red lipstick stands under a vibrant red maple tree in a traditional Korean courtyard; she wears a black furry hat with ear-like protrusions and a black coat, smiling and glancing back at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a medium full shot of her standing against a brick wall with traditional grey roof tiles, where she adjusts her hat and smiles warmly under the bright sunlight. (3) She is seen sitting on a wooden bench in a courtyard blanketed with yellow ginkgo leaves; she looks up at the sky and then leans back, looking playful while holding a black shawl. (4) The woman walks gracefully along a stone path beside a pond with a traditional wooden pavilion in the background; the sky is clear blue and the water is still, reflecting the architecture. (5) A selfie-style shot captures her and a female friend in front of the white N Seoul Tower, with both women looking up at the structure with curious expressions. (6) Close-up shots of grilled eel on a charcoal grill and bowls of kimchi are presented on a wooden table. (7) At night, the woman is seen using outdoor gym equipment, specifically a leg-raise station, laughing and enjoying the activity in a urban park setting. (8) She appears in a close-up wearing a pink furry hat, sipping from a white cup with a yellow straw in a bright outdoor environment. (9) A close-up shows a large metal pan filled with sizzling gopchang (intestines), vegetables, and chives being stirred with tongs. (10) The woman poses with her arms outstretched in front of a grand traditional palace building (Gyeongbokgung) under a clear sky. (11) Finally, she stands on an observation deck overlooking a dense urban cityscape with mountains in the far distance, wearing a black leather jacket and a white turtleneck.
